name: GymMemberRetentionRiskConsole
tagline: Spot members about to leave, work the save desk and prove the save rate – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete member-retention app for gyms, health clubs and studios in one PCF control: transparent churn-risk score from visits, trend, payments, tenure, contract end, no-shows and NPS; revenue at risk; risk queue with bulk outreach; save desk with freeze and save-attempt rules; join-month cohort retention; club, plan and coach comparison. Works in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages, with demo data out of the box.
features: Risk score 0–100 with drivers and playbooks
17 quick filters, grouping by top driver
Bulk flag for outreach and assign coach
Contact log with next follow-up and overdue tracking
Club × plan heat map and coach save rates
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
